titulo: Refill the paper before you leave the printer
caption:
Refill the paper before you leave the printer

The printer is out of paper. Cella brings a fresh ream and loads the tray before she leaves.

For whoever refills the paper before leaving.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A pale blue-gray hallway. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, looking at a gray printer on the right. A bubble over the printer says no paper. The bubble goes away. A white ream of paper floats across and settles into the tray on top of the printer. A star appears and the figure's eyes close in a smile as it pulses. The text stays: 1 empty printer, refilled before leaving. The last card: for whoever refills the paper before leaving, Choose friction.
